limitations: Host route wrappers embed actual process/incident components; a diagnostic Router/RouteView is used. Production RouteView/auth middleware/OIDC/startup are not qualified.

Authentication, FIELD service, typed recorded/incident clients, native source evidence and one-effect outcome persistence are controlled fixtures. No actual domain database write or provider/transaction qualification is inferred.

Shared StatusBadge and unrelated maintenance/journal/work-order/transition components are not source-linked in this component runtime. Their visuals and branches are not qualified; the terminal confirmation text and relevant HSE controls were observed.
The browser mismatch check uses full navigation. Same-page query-change handling remains covered by the recorded focused component gate, not a new browser observation.
Selected navigation/recovery/narrow viewport only; no full accessibility/screen-reader/keyboard/RTL/browser matrix or production branding acceptance.
No SQL, EF, schema, task persistence or application source change in this qualification turn. Overall plan/goal and commit/push remain pending.
